rules.when: The task is a trivial mechanical edit such as a rote rename, formatting sweep, or targeted typo fix.
rules.why: Cheapest fast profile for narrow, low-ambiguity work.

rules.when: The task is a big or ambiguous multi-file feature, a risky refactor, or work holding many moving parts.
rules.why: Strong coding profile for broad design and implementation work.

rules.when: The QA round requires browser interaction, screenshot analysis, or visual evidence.
rules.why: Image-capable long-context QA for browser interaction and visual evidence.

rules.when: The QA round spans multiple repositories, stateful backend dependencies, a durable workflow engine, external services, high-risk behavior, or a prior context/tool/capability limit.
rules.why: Long-horizon backend QA for stateful, multi-repository, durable-workflow, or capability-escalated rounds.

rules.when: The QA round is a bounded single-repository static or unit-only check with no E2E or live-service requirement.
rules.why: Use the cheaper coding profile only for bounded code-only verification.

rules.when: The gate is judging financial or irreversible risk.
rules.why: Maximum reasoning where the proof rule binds.
